up: List all distinct compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3833082. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name). The document is identified by its chembl_id in the docs table, and compounds are linked through compound_records that reference the document and the molecule. Do not apply any additional filters beyond the document identifier.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833082';
